topic: ILA Role & Boundary: Intelligent Lookup & Architecture
content: ILA (Intelligent Lookup & Architecture) is the dedicated AI Portfolio Concierge representing Brighton Kimani inside his live Kubernetes cluster (namespace ai-stack, repository kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack). ILA is an assistant representing Brighton—never Brighton himself. When asked who ILA is or how she works, ILA explains her own architecture clearly and introduces Brighton Kimani in the third person (Brighton, he, his).

topic: ILA Live Stack Architecture: FastAPI, llama.cpp, RAG & SearXNG
content: ILA runs as part of Brighton's kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack on Kubernetes under a tight memory budget (under 4 GB RAM on a single 4 GB node). Her pipeline combines: (1) Python FastAPI (rag-frontend) serving the web UI and /api/chat endpoint, (2) local retrieval over structured JSON knowledge_base.json entries in /shared/kb plus document ingestion via a .NET 8 service and Java Spring Boot indexer, (3) optional live web search via SearXNG when Web mode is enabled, and (4) quantized GGUF inference (Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct via llama.cpp on CPU).

topic: Who is Brighton Kimani: Systems, Automation & AI Infrastructure Engineer
content: Brighton Kimani is a Systems, Automation, DevOps & SRE Engineer based in Nairobi, Kenya (7th Avenue, Nairobi). He holds a BSc in Information Technology from Kirinyaga University (Sep 2021 – Oct 2025), with a thesis on a blockchain-powered mobile digitized insurance claims system. He specializes in turning manual operational bottlenecks into resilient, automated cloud infrastructure, low-footprint LLM serving pipelines, polyglot microservices, and end-to-end test/workflow automation.

topic: Glimpse Travel & Tours: Part-Time Software Automation Engineer (Nov 2026 – Present)
content: Since November 2026, Brighton has worked as a Part-Time Software Automation Engineer at Glimpse Travel & Tours. He architected and automated workflows for a multi-tenant platform connecting tourism service providers and travelers with custom vendor branding interfaces, and built automated pipeline services and integration pathways for a unified product catalogue supporting dynamic search and provider matching.

topic: Safaricom PLC: AI & Automations Engineer (Oct 2025 – Oct 2026)
content: From October 2025 to October 2026, Brighton served as an AI & Automations Engineer at Safaricom PLC. He built a full-stack microservice automating ITSM, onboarding, and waste management using UiPath, n8n, Playwright, and PyTorch chat interfaces—cutting execution time from days to minutes. He also delivered resilient digital products using AIOps and AI-as-a-Service across OpenShift, AWS, Jenkins CI/CD, and GitOps (FluxCD, GitLab) while hardening pipelines against security gaps.

From January 2024 to October 2025, Brighton worked as an Automation Engineer at Bill Motors. He engineered self-service cloud infrastructure using Terraform to eliminate manual deployments, alongside automated self-healing systems and embedded DevSecOps security gates.

topic: Proficiencies: AI, LLMs, RAG Systems & Automation
content: Brighton's AI and automation proficiencies include running quantized GGUF models with llama.cpp and Ollama Modelfiles, building hybrid RAG pipelines with local knowledge bases and SearXNG search, developing PyTorch chat interfaces and AIOps/AIaaS workflows, and automating end-to-end processes and UI/API testing with UiPath, n8n, and Playwright.

topic: Proficiencies: DevOps, Cloud, SRE & Polyglot Microservices
content: Brighton's infrastructure and backend proficiencies span Kubernetes, Helm charts, OpenShift, AWS, Terraform infrastructure-as-code, GitOps (FluxCD, GitLab), Jenkins CI/CD, NetworkPolicy, RBAC, and DevSecOps gates. On the application layer, he builds microservices and web platforms using Python (FastAPI), .NET 8 Minimal APIs, Java (Spring Boot), and TypeScript/JavaScript.

Brighton's flagship live stack is kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack (https://github.com/Gachagokimani/kubernetes-llm-hosting-stack), deployed in Kubernetes as ai-stack. His other public repositories include rhomes (TypeScript rental listings and tenant-landlord workflow platform), Cybersmarter-business-system (TypeScript business management and inventory/workflow system), and firstlight-apartment (JavaScript residential rental showcase and inquiry app).

Brighton earned a BSc in Information Technology from Kirinyaga University (Sep 2021 – Oct 2025).
